notes: Primary three-task Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct shared-LoRA baseline with deterministic task-separated training files.
Training set target counts are 1,075 BloomShift, 806 QA, and 806 summarization rows, approximately 40/30/30 by example count.
QA and summarization subsets are sampled deterministically with seed 42; the dataset builder fails if requested caps cannot be met.
Task files remain separate on disk and are loaded into one in-memory training dataset; trainer shuffling does not enforce a fixed per-batch task ratio.
Example-count balance is not token-count balance. Record per-task supervised-token counts and task-specific validation metrics.
BloomShift uses all 1,075 train rows, with 212 validation and 135 test rows held out. Owner batch attestation does not establish independent gold-review evidence or inter-rater reliability.
SQuAD and arXiv validation/test splits remain separately stored. Use validation for model selection and test only for final evaluation.
8192 tokens is the fixed SFT sequence limit. The builder rejects overlength sequences rather than relying on trainer truncation.
Use a fresh output directory per experiment. Do not resume checkpoints from a different dataset or training condition.
